name: Lag Reducer
description: Particle optimization plus optional low-graphics, glow, and particle visibility switches.

enabled.name: Enable particle budget optimization
enabled.description: Master switch for reducing particle emission and capacity. Turn off to restore normal particle budgets.

particle-draw-reduction.name: Particle optimization strength
particle-draw-reduction.description: 0 = normal. 1-10 reduce particle emission and maximum capacity; 10 keeps about 1% of each supported emitter budget (at least one slot for small emitters).

ultra-low.name: Enable low-graphics mode
ultra-low.description: Master switch for the extra visual reductions below. Applies when entering the main menu or a level and when changing this setting.

disable-glow.name: Disable glow effects
disable-glow.description: Turns off the game glow option while low-graphics mode is enabled. Some levels may look different.

hide-particles.name: Hide game particles
hide-particles.description: Turns off the game particle option while low-graphics mode is enabled. Use this for the strongest visual reduction.

performance-logs.name: Performance logs
performance-logs.description: Write a short diagnostic message to the Geode log when visual settings are applied.
